1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 2 m de longitud, de aletas radiadas, cuerpo alargado de color plateado, con varias filas de color amarillento y pequeñas manchas amarillas; su carne es muy apreciada. Scombridae, Scomberomorus regalis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 2 meters in length, characterized by radiated fins and a elongated body with a silvery color, featuring multiple rows of yellowish hues and small yellow spots; its flesh is highly prized. Scombridae, Scomberomorus regalis.
